provenance.recorded: 2026-10-31, observed from a live three-way arbitration run (`python -X utf8 -m symmetry_court arbitrate --emit-expected-template`); the receipt is verdicts/tcp.verdict.json; the gate (`python -X utf8 -m symmetry_court selftest`) replays the case and compares these rows field-by-field
provenance.reading_guide: relabel row = actions may be renamed along with states (diagnostic contrast reading for an event-class model); fixed row = event names pinned (the protocol-true reading, declared in each group file); networkx columns = independent juror

swap.claim: defendant A: FIN-WAIT-2 (waiting for the peer's FIN) and CLOSING (waiting for the peer's ACK of our FIN) are drawn as shape-twins -- one outgoing edge each, both into TIME-WAIT -- so the two termination paths could be swapped and compressed into one

other.claim: defendant B: FIN-WAIT-1 and SYN-RECEIVED are both middle states with three outgoing edges, so they could be swapped

absurd.claim: defendant C (control): CLOSED and ESTABLISHED -- a connection's starting state and its main working state -- could be swapped

pads.claim: positive control: padding states 11 and 12 have byte-identical rows (every event self-loops, reward 0), so the swap is a genuine symmetry under BOTH readings and should be admitted everywhere
